gitCommit.subject: test: recognize structured speaking pillar evidence
gitCommit.body:
test: recognize structured speaking pillar evidence

Corrige falsos positivos do auditor auditSpeaking, sem tocar conteudo, factory
ou outros pilares. O auditor checava nomes legados (pronunciationTips/
shadowingTasks/repeatTasks) que createSpeakingLesson nem gera; a pronuncia real
esta em pronunciationChunks/repeatAfterMe.

- Modelo (hasSpeakingModel): modelPhrases/speakingModel/modelAnswer/
  exampleDialogue/guidedModel/usefulPhrases/sentenceFrames/dialogue +
  repeatAfterMe + substitutionDrills/questionAnswerDrills/buildYourAnswer +
  speakingSituation(>=40).
- Pronuncia (hasSpeakingPronunciation): + pronunciationChunks + repeatAfterMe +
  fluencyDrills/intonationPractice/stressPractice/minimalPairs.
- Producao (hasSpeakingProduction): + roleplay/conversationTask/
  finalSpeakingTask/recordingTasks + tasks/guidedPractice (instrucao >=30) +
  prompt(>=40).

NAO mascara: ~52 P1 permanecem (33 B1+ sem pronuncia, 18 B2-007+/C1/C2 sem
modelo, 1 sem producao) — gap real de conteudo.

Validacao local (iPhone 13 + iPhone SE):
- pillar-quality: P0 0, P1 127 -> 83, P2 220
- exercise-quality: P0 0, P1 0 (intacto)
- lesson-quality: P0 0, P1 0 (intacto)
- Speaking P1: 96 -> 52
- Listening 16, Reading 14, Vocabulary 1, Grammar 0, Writing 0 (sem regressao)
- "Resposta correta nao aparece": 0
